`content/` holds bilingual topics; keep `_index.de.md`/`_index.en.md` siblings with mirrored, synced YAML front matter (`title`, `date`, `draft`, `weight`, `archetype`; prefer ISO timestamps). Extend `layouts/partials/` and `layouts/shortcodes/` overrides, never `themes/hugo-theme-relearn`; `layouts/shortcodes/svg.html` pulls from `svg/`. Styling: `assets/css/theme-grafioschtrader.css`; pass-through files in `static/`; reusable diagrams in `svg/` or beside embedding Markdown. Hugo-generated `public/`/`resources/` should only be refreshed via `hugo --cleanDestinationDir`. Use Hugo Extended v0.120+.

Use lowercase domain folders/filenames and nearby media. Reserve `#` for titles; use `##`/`###`, Markdown lists/tables, and existing shortcodes (`{{% notice %}}`, `{{< svg icon="..." >}}`, mermaid fences, etc.). Keep styling changes inside `assets/css/theme-grafioschtrader.css`.

`hugo server --disableFastRender -D --buildFuture --navigateToChanged`
`hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings --cleanDestinationDir`
`hugo server --renderToDisk --printUnusedTemplates`
Run `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings` before every commit; today that build is the test suite. Add `--i18n-warnings --printUnusedTranslations --printPathWarnings`. Spot-check `public/search/index.json` and affected HTML in Chromium and Firefox. Include regenerated `public/` artifacts whenever the published site changes; avoid mixing content with layout/CSS. Use focused imperative commits. PRs list touched sections, link Grafioschtrader issues, attach styling screenshots/zipped `public/`, and state whether `hugo --gc --minify` ran clean.
